static_traits.name: Li Ming
static_traits.family_status: Has two children, one of whom has autism; keeps two dogs
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with other parents are affected, feels alienated and hard to connect
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness history; never received psychotherapy; the problem started after the child was diagnosed with autism and gradually worsened
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent thinking, Good cooperativeness; neutral tone; marked self-criticism and comparison tendencies, occasional Avoids socializing

basic_info.main_problem: Because some friends have more children, I feel I am not good enough as a parent, developing Self-doubt and questioning my parenting ability. These feelings started after the child was diagnosed with autism and gradually worsened, especially marked in Social situations with other parents.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to be more confident as a parent and stop the constant Self-doubt; I hope to manage stress better so I can be there for my children.
growth_experiences: After the child was diagnosed with autism, Li Ming began feeling long-term parenting pressure and uncertainty, struggling to balance the different needs of Two children. No similar psychological problems had appeared before, nor had psychotherapy been received; No major physical illness history. Over time the problem worsened through comparison with other parents - especially when seeing others with more children seemingly managing better at Social gatherings, Li Ming tended more toward Self-doubt and negation.

core_beliefs: I am inferior to other parents

special_situations.event: At Social gatherings with other parents, seeing some friends with more children who seem to manage with ease
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not had more children like them and still coped with ease, it means I am not competent enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeks comfort and approval from friends and online parenting forums
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough / I did not do well enough

special_situations.event: After the child was diagnosed with autism, daily life requires balancing needs and care between two children
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot meet all the needs of Two children at once, it proves I am a failure as a parent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding socializing with other parents to reduce Self-doubt and stress
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never be as good as those parents

special_situations.event: Observes that other parents with more children seem to handle parenting and life better
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Their ease means my incompetence; it is all my problem and fault
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly self-reviewing, raising standards, trying to make up for supposed inadequacies; continuously seeking others' approval
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all because I am not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a competent parent, able to steadily care for two children's needs
core_conflict.fear: Fearing appearing not good enough in comparisons, being judged a failure by others, thus affecting relationships with children and other parents
defense_goal: Relieve insecurity by seeking external recognition
Reducing the risk of being compared and evaluated through Avoids socializing, maintaining a sense of security

object_relations.object_representation: More capable and judgmental other parents

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing other parents seemingly managing more children with ease at Social gatherings, or being asked about parenting experience
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Seeing others' ease as a negation of myself, believing 'I am not good enough', and attributing stress and negative evaluations to my own inadequacy (transference: self-criticism)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-blaming and absolutist expressions (like 'it is all because I am not good enough'), reducing contact with others, avoiding discussing my positive side and concrete facts; heavy tone, guilt.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to challenge negative automatic thoughts or try new cognitive frameworks
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Presumes change will be difficult, worries about failing again and being judged, therefore keeps a cautious distance
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone is cautious and reserved; expresses concerns (such as 'this is hard') while accepting small attempts but emphasizing risks and difficulty, avoiding overcommitment.

manifestations: Avoiding socializing with other parents to reduce Self-doubt
Feels alienated at gatherings, hard to connect with others
Feeling discomfort expressing parenting insecurity, reducing self-disclosure

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent self-criticism (like 'I am not good enough')
Over-comparing and worrying about others' views
Being cautious in social interactions, Withdrawal, struggling to express needs genuinely

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: Avoids direct communication with other parents to evade being compared
Turns attention to online forums seeking comfort rather than facing real-life interaction
Avoiding deep conversations at gatherings, Displacing topics

positive_force: Devotes much time and energy to the child; has a sense of responsibility
Willing to seek help and accept counseling, expresses willingness to change
Has a certain support network (friends to talk about daily challenges with)
negative_force: Excessively comparing with others, prone to Self-denial
Depends on external approval (seeking comfort) but with limited effect
Avoiding Social situations, Reinforcing isolation and Self-doubt
Internalizes stress and negative evaluations, forming self-criticism

antecedent: Seeing other parents seem more capable at Social gatherings, or realizing others have more children
target_behavior.core_reason: Comparing with others triggering self-judgment and shame, worrying about being judged an incompetent parent
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome emotions (shame, Anxiety) and being-compared situations
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal alienation, increased Loneliness, maintaining and worsening Self-doubt and stress

target_behavior.behavior: Excessively seeking external comfort and reassurance (frequently seeking confirmation from friends and online parenting forums)
antecedent: When Self-doubt appears or feeling uneasy after comparisons
target_behavior.core_reason: Tying self-worth to external approval, trying to reduce Anxiety through others' opinions
target_behavior.function: Gains short-term emotional relief and a sense of recognition
target_behavior.consequence: Unable to form an inner self-evaluation system, the problem cycle continues, Anxiety and Self-doubt not yet markedly relieved

target_behavior.behavior: Self-critical speech and thoughts (like 'I am not good enough' 'I did not do well enough')
antecedent: In situations where the needs of two children are hard to balance
target_behavior.core_reason: Negating the positive, overgeneralizing, extending single or local difficulties into overall failure
target_behavior.function: Maintains an obsession with control and perfect standards, trying to promote improvement through self-blame
target_behavior.consequence: Rising Anxiety and stress, affecting interaction with children and daily life quality
